jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
About Seqera

Seqera is on a mission to empower scientists and organizations to solve humanity’s biggest challenges through data-driven science. As the company behind Nextflow and the Seqera Platform, we enable global enterprises, biotech innovators, academic institutions, and public sector organizations to scale complex data workflows with confidence.

We’re a global, remote-friendly team with headquarters in Barcelona and colleagues across the US, UK, and beyond. As we continue to grow, we’re strengthening our internal foundations - and that’s where you come in.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Unified Compute team and take ownership of the application layer that turns computational capability into something our customers can configure, run, and pay for - spanning Seqera Intelligent Compute, its integration with the Seqera Platform, and the metering and billing that sits behind them. This layer is essential to our customer-facing platform's operational success: it determines whether biotech innovators and researchers can set up the compute they need, run their workloads reliably wherever they run them, and see transparent, accurate insight into what they used and what it cost.

You will help shape a backend that supports compute environment provisioning across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, HPC schedulers and GPU executions; multi-tenant usage tracking and accurate billing computation across cloud and on-prem deployments; and the pay-as-you-go and free-tier onboarding journeys that bring new users onto the platform. The role spans high-impact engineering work - from system architecture design to data modeling, cloud provider integrations, and API development - using JVM technologies (Java, Groovy, Micronaut).

You will be empowered to influence our architecture decisions, improve the lifecycle of compute provisioning and billing processes, and collaborate closely with product, platform, and infrastructure teams to deliver world-class engineering outcomes. It is a broad scope, and you will own it end to end, with three engineers alongside you in the team to lean on for the hardest calls.

What You'll Do

Build and own the integration between Seqera Intelligent Compute and the Seqera Platform.
Own Platform compute environments: let customers set up and run compute across AWS, Azure and GCP, Kubernetes, HPC schedulers, and GPU-enabled executions - and handle the ways those backends differ.
Build against cloud provider APIs and SDKs, and handle what the real world returns: partial failures, quota and permission errors, provider quirks that leak into the product.
Own the billing and pay-as-you-go path - metering usage accurately, keeping usage events and invoices reconcilable, and making the free-user onboarding journey work.
Design data models and APIs that stay consistent across services and releases.
Make failures legible: turn raw provider and scheduler errors into something a user can act on, and add the tests and observability that make the next incident faster to diagnose.
Work directly with the Platform and product teams, and with support on escalations from real customers.
Take design decisions within your scope and document the system so it is not dependent on any one person.

About You

4+ years building and operating production backend services, with real ownership of at least one.
Strong in Java and/or Groovy, with Micronaut, Spring Boot or similar.
Real hands-on experience with a major cloud provider's API - provisioning and managing resources programmatically, not just deploying to it.
Have worked with Kubernetes as somewhere workloads actually run.
You care about correctness. Ideally you have worked on billing, metering or other systems where wrong data has consequences - and if not, you bring the same rigour to data integrity anyway.
Comfortable designing REST APIs and data models, and keeping integrations working across versions and failures.
Have been accountable for something customer-facing in production.
Comfortable inheriting a system, asking questions, and writing down what was never documented.
Comfortable with ambiguity - you develop hypotheses with limited information, drive work independently, and reach out early to stay unblocked.
We use AI every day and expect engineers to use it extensively. You do not need to be an expert, but you must be genuinely open to it.

Nice to have:

Multiple clouds - hands-on across two or more of AWS, Azure, GCP.
HPC and batch schedulers (Slurm, LSF, PBS, AWS Batch, Google Batch, Azure Batch).
GPU workloads and GPU-enabled provisioning.
Usage-based billing or monetization platforms (Metronome, Stripe) and pay-as-you-go pricing.
Self-serve or free-tier product work: signup funnels, usage limits, conversion.
Bioinformatics, Nextflow, or scientific computing background.
Observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK) and CI/CD ownership.
Some frontend exposure (Angular).
Open-source contributions

Great benefits

Time off: 23 days for vacations per year, 3 days given by Seqera in December, and the national/public holidays according to your location.
Equity
Private health insurance
Private life insurance
Home office allowance (valued over 1,000 USD)
Subscription to Oliva, Mental Health App
Learning and development budget per year (1,000 USD)

jobs.title: .NET / Angular Developer (M/F)
jobs.description:
As part of ADENES Group, we believe expertise is not only about solving complex challenges, it's about supporting people when they need it most. As a global leader in loss adjusting and claims management, we bring together 4,500+ employees across 120+ countries worldwide, including 40 directly operated countries, to deliver trusted expertise, meaningful human connections and innovative solutions. Together, we help insurers, businesses and individuals move forward with confidence, wherever they are in the world.

You will join the Innovation & IT Projects Department, within the Group IT division, which designs and delivers the digital solutions used by our business units across the world.

Reporting to the IT manager, within a team of developers, you will make sure that the projects you work on meet the needs of the business units and deliver the value expected by the company.

Your missions

Deliver your project goals while respecting quality standards, deadlines and the technical choices defined by the IT department
Take part in daily operations (RUN) and help keep our applications reliable
Apply the testing practices defined by the team
Create and maintain clear project documentation
Work within the team's Agile methodology (Scrum and Kanban)
Contribute to the continuous improvement of our development processes

Your environment

A fully Microsoft-based ecosystem, with Azure DevOps for delivery.

Technical stack:

.NET
C#
SQL
Azure Functions
Angular

Profil

Must-have

Master's degree or engineering degree in Computer Science
At least 3 years of successful experience as a developer, with concrete achievements
Hands-on experience with .NET / C# and SQL
Fluent English

Nice-to-have

Experience with Azure Functions and Angular
A first exposure to project management or Agile ceremonies

You are recognised for your precision and your enthusiasm. You listen carefully and communicate clearly with both technical and business stakeholders.

What we offer :

Permanent contract, full-time
Salary: €40,000 – €45,000 gross per year (fixed), depending on experience
Benefits: 8€ meal vouchers, health insurance etc.
A hybrid working model combining fixed and flexible days, so everyone can choose what suits them best (over 100 days per year)
A structured onboarding combining practical and theoretical phases to understand our business
Training and career development opportunities, including internal mobility within the Group
An international, collaborative environment with an entrepreneurial culture, driven by innovation and human values

Our recruitment process: HR call → technical interview with the IT team → final interview with the CTO.

If you want to join an agile company with an entrepreneurial culture, focused on innovation and human values, and recognize yourself in this profile, join us !

Within the ADENES Group, we are convinced that diversity is a strength. We act inclusively toward everyone, respecting differences. We are committed to evaluating applications without regard to gender, age, origin, disability, or beliefs. Our diversity policy thus ensures equal treatment of all applications. Furthermore, the ADENES Group offers equal career opportunities for candidates with equivalent qualifications
